name: baba_always_bypasses_anti-bot
description: Pi extension over the Camoufox anti-fingerprint browser — the agent writes fixed-step web workflows down as self-healing skills it maintains and fixes itself, so each repeat costs one bash call instead of burning LLM tokens. Log in by hand once; watch it
